description: Recommend up to 3 perfumes for a person's taste. Give any structured preferences you know (scent families, loved and avoided notes, perfumes they love, gender, budget, strength, occasion, climate) and optionally the person's own short request text. Supports gifts: set gift=true (or gift_recipient_gender / gift_occasion / gift_budget_max_usd, or a gendered gift_recipient) and describe the recipient's taste; the gift_ fields take the recipient's lean, the relationship, the occasion and the gift budget. Each pick returns notes, longevity and projection scores, price where known, how much community evidence backs it, reasons, honest trade-offs against a named perfume, a buy-or-sample advice, and a scendira.com product page link.

climate.description: Climate it will be worn in.
climate.title: Climate

gender_lean.description: Who it is for: feminine, masculine, unisex (unisex scents only) or any. For a gift, the recipient's.
gender_lean.title: Gender Lean

gift.description: True when choosing for someone else.
gift.title: Gift

gift_budget_max_usd.description: Highest bottle price in USD for the gift. Wins over budget_max_usd.
gift_budget_max_usd.title: Gift Budget Max Usd

gift_occasion.description: The gift's occasion. date_night, everyday and office steer the picks; birthday, anniversary and the other moments are noted only.
gift_occasion.title: Gift Occasion

gift_recipient.description: The recipient's relationship to the person (optional). wife, husband, mother, son ... make the ask a gift and set the recipient's lean when none is given.
gift_recipient.title: Gift Recipient

gift_recipient_gender.description: The recipient's lean: feminine, masculine, unisex (unisex scents only) or any. Wins over gender_lean and over the relationship.
gift_recipient_gender.title: Gift Recipient Gender

loves_perfumes.description: Perfumes the person already loves (brand + name), used as the reference for similar picks (max 3).
loves_perfumes.title: Loves Perfumes

notes_avoided.description: Notes or materials to avoid, e.g. ['oud', 'patchouli'] (max 8).
notes_avoided.title: Notes Avoided

notes_loved.description: Specific notes the person wants, e.g. ['vanilla', 'pistachio'] (max 8).
notes_loved.title: Notes Loved

request_text.description: The person's own short request, read for stated preferences only (not stored).
request_text.title: Request Text

scent_families.description: Scent families the person likes. woody covers woody, oud, leather and smoky.
scent_families.title: Scent Families

sensitivities.description: Broad dislikes: too_sweet, too_strong, too_smoky, synthetic.
sensitivities.title: Sensitivities

name: recommend_perfumes

depth.description: adequate = enough independent discussion to lean on; thin = little; none = catalogue facts only.
depth.title: Depth

mentions.description: Community posts and comments that name it.
mentions.title: Mentions

voices.description: Community voices behind this perfume: people discussing it in the communities we read (engagement-weighted). The same count Dira's evidence floor uses.
voices.title: Voices

other.description: Notes listed without a top/heart/base position.
other.title: Other

blind_buy_safety_0_10.description: Scendira score for how safe a blind buy is; null below its evidence gate.
blind_buy_safety_0_10.title: Blind Buy Safety 0 10

product_page_url.description: The perfume's page on scendira.com (offers, notes, Dira); null if none.
product_page_url.title: Product Page Url

role.description: The slot this pick fills, e.g. 'Best Match', 'Longest Lasting'.
role.title: Role

trade_offs.description: Honest differences from the reference perfume.
trade_offs.title: Trade Offs

basis.description: Set when the price is for a pack or set.
basis.title: Basis

size_ml.description: Bottle size the price buys, when stated.
size_ml.title: Size Ml

usd.description: Listing price in USD; null when unknown.
usd.title: Usd

did_you_mean.description: Close catalogue names when this one was not found.
did_you_mean.title: Did You Mean

note.description: How the name was read, when it needed a choice.
note.title: Note

Understood.description: What the engine ran on, after the inputs were merged.

from_reference.description: What was taken from the named perfume because the person left it open (e.g. 'family:woody', 'note:oud', 'gender:masculine'); not listed above.
from_reference.title: From Reference

Understood.title: Understood

about.default: Answer from Dira, Your Fragrance Finder, made by Scendira (scendira.com). Picks come from Scendira's matching engine over its catalogue and independent community discussion (Reddit, YouTube, TikTok, Facebook); posts are counted and summarised, never quoted. Ranking is margin-blind: no brand or seller pays for placement. Scores are 0-10. Prices are USD where known and can change; the product page has the current offers.
